entries.def:
ἀκολουθέω, -ῶ 
(ἀκόλουθος, following; ἀ- cop., κέλευθος, poët., away), [in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ ;] 
to accompany, follow: Mat.4.25, al. Metaphorical, of discipleship: Mat.9.9, Mrk.9.38, Jhn.12.26, al. Absol.: Mat.18.10 more freq., with dative (cl.), Mat.8.1, al.; before μετά, with genitive, (cl.; Eutherford, N.Phr., 458 f.), Luk.9.49 ὀπίσω, with genitive (Heb. הָלַךְ אָהֲרֵי), Mat.10.38 (cf. ἐξ-, ἐπ-, κατ-, παρ-,…

ἀκούω, 
[in LXX chiefly for שׁמע ] 
to hear, listen, attend, perceive by hearing, comprehend by hearing. 
__1. Intrans.: Mrk.4.3; 7.37, Jas.2.5, Rev.2.7, al.; τ. ὠσίν, Mat.13.15 (LXX); with cogn. dative, ακοῇ ἀ. (see: ἀκοή), Mat.13.14, Act.28.26" (LXX) ; ὁ ἔχων ὦτα (οὖς) ἀκούειν, ἀκουσάτω, Mat.11.15, Mrk.4.23, Rev.2.7, al. 
__2. Trans., prop. with accusative of thing(s), of thing heard, genitive of person(s), from…

ἀκρασία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀκρατής, which see), [in LXX: 1Ma.6.26 * ;] 
in Arist. and later writers = ἀκράτεια (Lft., Notes, 222 f.), want of power, hence want of self-control, incontinence: Mat.23.25, 1Co.7.5.†
(AS)

ἀκρατής, -ές
(κράτος), [in LXX: Pro.27.20 * ;] 
__(a) powerless, impotent; 
__(b) in moral sense, lacking self-control, incontinent: 2Ti.3.3.†
(AS)

ἄκρατος, -ον
(κεράννυμι), [in LXX: Psa.75.8 (חֲמַר), Jer.25.15 (חֵמָה), 3Ma.5.2 * ;] 
unmixed, pure: οἶνος, Rev.14.10.†
(AS)

ἀκρίβεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἀκριβής), [in LXX: Dan.7.16 (יַצִּיב), Wis.12.21, Sir.16.25; 42.4 * ;] 
exactness, precision (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word): Act.22.3.†
(AS)

ἀκριβής, -ές 
[in LXX: Dan LXX 2:45 6:12 (יַצִּיב) Dan.4.25, Est.4.5, Sir.18.29; 19.25; 31.24; 32.3 * ;] 
exact, precise, careful, of things and persons: superl., Act.26.5.†
(AS)

ἀκριβῶς 
adv. (ἀκριβής), [in LXX: Deu.19.18 (יָטַב), Dan.7.19 (יְצֵב), Ezk.39.14, Wis.19.18, Sir.18.29 ;] 
with exactness, carefully: Mat.2.8, Luk.1.3, Act.18.25, Eph.5.15, 1Th.5.2 (M, Th., in l). Compar., ἀκριβέστερον (Milligan, NTD, 111; MM, VGT, see word), Act.18.26; 23.15, 20; 24.22.†
(AS)

ἀκριβόω, -ῶ
(ἀκριβής), [in Aq.: Isa.30.8; 49.16 * ;] 
to enquire with exactness, learn carefully: Mat.2.7, 16 (for similar ex., see MM, VGT, sv.).†
(AS)

ἀκριβῶς 
adv. (ἀκριβής), [in LXX: Deu.19.18 (יָטַב), Dan.7.19 (יְצֵב), Ezk.39.14, Wis.19.18, Sir.18.29 ;] 
with exactness, carefully: Mat.2.8, Luk.1.3, Act.18.25, Eph.5.15, 1Th.5.2 (M, Th., in l). Compar., ἀκριβέστερον (Milligan, NTD, 111; MM, VGT, see word), Act.18.26; 23.15, 20; 24.22.†
(AS)
